name: NeRF with Global Animation Code
aliases: NeRF extended with global animation code
definition: An extension of NeRF that learns a continuous function of scene radiance (RGB and opacity) conditioned on scene coordinates, viewing direction, and a global animation code to handle dynamic sequences.
summary: NeRF with Global Animation Code renders dynamic scenes by conditioning a standard NeRF on a 256-dimensional feature vector generated from input data.
